card.name: Verbs after captured or convicted people
card.fires_on: Small words like was, to, and, were right after a person or group is captured, tried or convicted, just before the outcome (sentence, acquittal, death). Mostly in historical accounts of trials and executions.

modes.label: Trial and sentencing
modes.description: Linking word after someone is found guilty or sentenced, before the penalty.
modes.example: Fidel was found guilty and sentenced<< to>> fifteen years in prison.

modes.label: Fate of a group
modes.description: Verb after a count of people killed, acquitted or escaped in a violent event.
modes.example: Ten of the men were killed in the raid, one<< got>> away, and seven were hanged,

modes.label: Apache restart commands
modes.description: Stray weak firing in Linux server instructions near the rc.d path.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about injury, wounding and harm to people.
card.plain: It fires on little words in stories where someone is tried, sentenced or killed, just before the outcome is stated.
